overlaps.ownership_rule: Alteração de escopo, item novo and 25%/50% belong to aditivos; measuring an already executed item and paying it belongs here.
Physical schedule, culpability and extension belong to atrasos; delay in processing a measurement or paying an accepted amount belongs here.
Recomposition from a supervening cost event belongs to reequilibrio; recognition and payment of executed quantities belongs here.
Reference price, SINAPI/SICRO and BDI audit belong to orçamento; contractual measurement criteria and payment belong here.
A broad second reading of one contract belongs to defesa-margem; the specific measurement/glosa decision and its content route to /medicoes-glosas-obras-publicas/.

gsc_baseline.interpretation: Brazilian qualified demand is the decision denominator. Foreign impressions and missing top rows never prove ICP demand or zero demand.

current_country_device.limitation: Search Analytics returns top rows only; no cluster row in the returned set is not an exhaustive zero.

historical_page_device.country_rule: Do not infer Brazil or use foreign traffic as ICP proof.

next_decision.evidence_window: one complete 28-day GSC window with country and device dimensions
next_decision.north_star: inbound qualified pipeline per month; clicks and impressions are diagnostic, not the corporate outcome

kill_rule.trigger: After a complete comparable 28-day window, kill further ownership/snippet work if the service remains at zero clicks while supporting content retains clicks, or if demand is informational-only at this volume.
kill_rule.action: Do not create another page. Preserve the ledger and return the next decision to offer/SERP or qualified-demand evidence.
kill_rule.rollback: Revert only the URL-exact decision that reduced qualified Brazilian impressions or shifted the owned query to a worse route.
